actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 334 - 51 (Roll no. 132). (text: CR H2119-2120)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 334 - 51 (Roll no. 132). (text: CR H2119-2120)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H2135-2136)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1263.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2119-2121)
Mr. Huizenga moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal diplomatic personnel, the Department of State, and up to 24 Members of Congress appointed to the U.S. Group.
dimensions.evidence: The United States Group shall be comprised of not more than 24 Members of Congress.

dimensions.assessment: Requires strategic reporting, diplomatic negotiations, and the formation of a legislative working group.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a strategy for bolstering engagement and cooperation with the Quad.

dimensions.assessment: Mentions reporting on additional resources needed and allows the group to accept private gifts or donations.
dimensions.evidence: additional resources needed to scale up and expand successful Quad initiatives and programs.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a federal agency report and authorizes the creation of a new inter-parliamentary working group.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State shall seek to enter into negotiations... with the goal of reaching a written agreement to establish a Quad Inter-Parliamentary Working Group

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual reporting requirements and an ongoing legislative group.
dimensions.evidence: The United States Group shall seek to meet not less frequently than annually

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for the creation and operation of the working group or report preparation.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the State Department to submit a strategy report on cooperation with the Quad and seek to establish an inter-parliamentary working group.
